assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one modular cozy pixel-game DAYTIME WINDOW SCENERY, full bleed opaque PNG, landscape exactly 4:3 ideally 1024x768. Reference cat is highest priority STYLE ONLY: crisp stepped pixel clusters and warm restrained shading. NO cat in output. Straight-ahead view outdoors with simple layers: pale blue sky upper 60 percent, two modest cream-white clouds around x=30% y=24% and x=70% y=33%, low rounded distant sage green tree silhouettes from y=58% to 78%, quiet grass and a few low plants lower 22%. Trees distributed across width with distinct crowns at x=22%,48%,75%, no important focal points in extreme corners. Calm clear sunny daytime, no sun necessary. Natural distant/near separation by flat colors, no perspective lines. Soft cheerful muted greens, pale blues, restrained warm highlights. Sharp square pixel clusters roughly 3-5 pixels at 1024 width, limited flat shaded steps, no blur or smooth painterly gradients. Keep shapes simple enough for matching exact night variant. NO humans, animals, buildings, cityscape, window frame, curtain, sill, wall, glass reflection, furniture, text, UI, watermarks, borders. This is scenery only that will sit BEHIND an independent frame.

Use case: lighting-weather. EDIT this exact daytime scenery into its matching NIGHT variant for an in-place game day/night switch. Preserve exact canvas 4:3, cropping, horizon, pixel art style, and ALL tree silhouette boundaries, crown positions, foliage masses and foreground plants and flower shapes at identical coordinates. Do NOT redraw, shift, enlarge, remove or rearrange ANY landscape shapes. Only recolor/relight the existing landscape: deep navy-blue sky, blue-gray distant trees, deeper desaturated blue foreground foliage with readable moonlight highlights, pale silver-blue flowers, NEVER pure black. Recolor existing two clouds to subdued night blue-gray while retaining outlines and positions. Add just 8 tiny sparse pixel stars in unobstructed sky and ONE small soft ivory pixel crescent moon centered around x=57% y=18%, away from corners and clouds. Moon glow represented in flat crisp pixel steps, no blur. No mountains or additional scenery. Keep all existing edges sharply pixel-stepped. NO frame, curtains, windowsill, glass, walls, furniture, people, animals, buildings, text, watermark, UI, border. Opaque full bleed PNG. CRITICAL exact matching landscape geometry and pixel dimensions to input; this is a palette and lighting conversion of same scene.

Crisp visible stepped pixel edges and flat cluster shading consistent with cat, simpler than cat. Sparse wood grain, no realistic texture, no gradients, no blur, no vector smoothing.
